name: Buy a feather for Veos

evidence.note: Budget five coins for a feather.

name: Accept Veos’s work

evidence.note: Veos supplies the scroll after X Marks the Spot.

name: Enchant a feather with Veos’s scroll

evidence.note: Use a feather on the scroll.

name: Interview Leenz

evidence.note: Ask what visitors can do in the city and record the answer. The five interviews can be done in any order.

name: Interview Horace

evidence.note: Ask what visitors can do in the city and record the answer. The five interviews can be done in any order.

name: Interview Jennifer

evidence.note: Ask what visitors can do in the city and record the answer. The five interviews can be done in any order.

name: Interview Munty

evidence.note: Ask what visitors can do in the city and record the answer. The five interviews can be done in any order.

name: Interview Regath

evidence.note: Ask what visitors can do in the city and record the answer. The five interviews can be done in any order.

name: Return the survey to Veos

evidence.note: Report all five interviews and receive the mysterious orb.

name: Activate the orb at the Dark Altar

evidence.note: Activate the orb near the altar and watch the client’s scene.

name: Report the Dark Altar visit to Veos

evidence.note: Veos awards the memoirs and two lamps. Completion enables Kourend Castle Teleport.

name: Accept Tomas Lawry’s investigation

evidence.note: Start the investigation in northern Port Piscarilius.

name: Ask about the Warrens and give Robert stew

evidence.note: Speak to the woman on the way to Robert, then give him a bowl of stew.

name: Take the assignment from Devan Rutter

evidence.note: Descend through the manhole and speak with Devan.

name: Complete Devan’s assignment at Conrad’s house

evidence.note: Use Conrad’s quest interaction and select a dialogue outcome.

name: Report the assignment to Devan

evidence.note: Return through the manhole and receive the introduction.

name: Speak to the Queen of Thieves

evidence.note: Learn where Hughes keeps the documents.

name: Pick the lock on Hughes’ chest

evidence.note: Pick the chest upstairs and take the letter.

name: Give Lawry the letter

evidence.note: Report the investigation before returning to the Warrens.

name: Receive the Queen of Thieves rewards

evidence.note: Shauna awards Thieving XP, coins and the Port Piscarilius memoir page. Warrens access remains available.

name: Ask Lord Kandur about Artur

evidence.note: Speak to Chef Olivia inside the house before leaving.

name: Find and read The Varlamore Envoy

evidence.note: Ask Galana which book Artur consulted, search the indicated shelves and read the book.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The book directs the player to Crabclaw Caves.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Ask Galana for the shelf and follow the current library hint.

name: Cross the Crabclaw Caves to Artur

evidence.note: Use the crevice and stepping stones, climb the rocks and descend to Artur.

name: Defeat the Sand Snake

evidence.note: Speak to Artur and defeat the snake in the lower cave.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The snake is defeated and the chest can be searched.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring suitable combat gear and food before entering.

name: Take the Royal Accord of Twill

evidence.note: Search the chest after the fight and speak to Artur.

name: Return the accord to Lord Kandur

evidence.note: Receive Agility XP, coins and the Hosidius memoir page.

name: Accept Lady Vulcana’s request

evidence.note: Lady Vulcana directs the player to Undor.

name: Ask Undor about Dinh’s hammer

evidence.note: Speak to Undor at the Wintertodt Camp.

name: Inspect the tower display case

evidence.note: Identify the mechanisms holding the hammer.

name: Take a tinderbox from the tower cupboard

evidence.note: Use the cupboard on the ground floor near the furnace if a tinderbox is needed.

name: Measure coolant and light the furnace

evidence.note: Find both jugs, measure the coolant using the dispenser, add it to the furnace and light the furnace.

name: Restore the basement power grid

evidence.note: Search for the crank, turn on the generator and reconnect the grid.

name: Restore the first-floor refinery

evidence.note: Read the cupboard notes, identify the correct fluid and use it to activate the refinery.

name: Rebalance the three upper-floor pylons

evidence.note: Move the disks among the three pylons in the required order to release the final lock.

name: Remove Dinh’s hammer

evidence.note: Open the display case after restoring the mechanisms.

name: Return the hammer to Undor

evidence.note: Give Undor the hammer before reporting back.

name: Report to Lady Vulcana

evidence.note: Receive Mining and Smithing XP, coins and the Lovakengj page. Minecart rides are now free.

name: Buy rope for the mountain crevice

evidence.note: Reserve enough coins for a rope.

name: Ask Mori about the disturbance

evidence.note: Mori asks the player to inform the council.

name: Warn Councillor Andrews

evidence.note: Find the councillor upstairs and explain Mori’s report.

name: Bring the councillor’s response to Mori

evidence.note: Mori directs the player to the Tower of Magic.

name: Enter the tower and defeat the tormented souls

evidence.note: Enter the quest instance and clear the souls on the ground floor.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The ground-floor souls have been defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring sufficient equipment, ammo or runes and food.

name: Speak to Lord Arceuus upstairs

evidence.note: Learn how to locate the soul of the deceased.

name: Ask Kaal-Ket-Jor about the soul

evidence.note: Use the dungeon lift, speak to Kaal-Ket-Jor and return to the surface.

name: Inspect the grave and track the soul

evidence.note: Follow the inspection trail from the grave to the final clue.

name: Defeat the trapped soul

evidence.note: Fight the trapped soul at the end of the trail.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The trapped soul encounter is resolved.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use suitable gear and food and finish the encounter before leaving.

name: Report the encounter to Kaal-Ket-Jor

evidence.note: Reenter the dungeon, report the encounter, then return to the surface.

name: Search the rocks near the Dark Altar

evidence.note: Inspect rocks until the device is found.

name: Report the discovery to Lord Arceuus

evidence.note: Receive Hunter XP, Runecraft XP, coins and the Arceuus memoir page.

name: Accept Phileas Rimor’s investigation

evidence.note: Phileas sends the player to the Arceuus Archive.

name: Ask Archeio to send you to the archive

evidence.note: Use the archive guardian’s teleport, then speak to Pagida.

name: Solve the archive combat-style puzzle

evidence.note: Move the device into position and switch between Melee, Ranged and Magic as the puzzle requires. Bare hands can be used for the melee strike.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The device is solved and the skeleton can be investigated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring ranged ammunition and runes and switch styles to match the device clues.

name: Investigate the skeleton in the archive

evidence.note: Inspect the skeleton beyond the device to learn what happened.

name: Report the archive discovery to Phileas

evidence.note: Phileas asks the player to consult Shiro.

name: Brief Shiro in the war tent

evidence.note: Speak to Shiro upstairs and learn about the mountain expedition.

name: Meet Duffy at Mount Quidamortem

evidence.note: Ask Duffy where to look for the cave entrance.

name: Secure rope at the crevice

evidence.note: Use the rope to make the crevice traversable.

name: Clear the rockfall and push the boulder

evidence.note: Descend, mine the rockfall and push the boulder to reach the barrier.

name: Defeat the corrupt lizardman

evidence.note: Try the barrier and complete the fight before investigating the altar.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The lizardman is defeated and the altar is accessible.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring suitable combat gear, food and antipoison if needed.

name: Inspect the unstable altar

evidence.note: Inspect the altar before returning to Duffy.

name: Bring Duffy to the cavern

evidence.note: Report the discovery to Duffy on the surface.

name: Return to the altar and speak to Gnosi

evidence.note: Descend the fixed rope, retrace the cave route, then speak to Duffy and Gnosi at the altar.

name: Tell Shiro what you found

evidence.note: Brief Shiro on the conversation at the altar.

name: Check Phileas’s tent

evidence.note: Follow up at Phileas’s tent before the final report.

name: Return to Shiro to finish the investigation

evidence.note: Receive coins, the Shayzien memoir page and the build 242 Mining XP reward.

name: Speak to Alina and watch the delegation arrive

evidence.note: Alina introduces the Varlamore delegation’s visit to Varrock.

name: Follow the suspicious guard through Varrock

evidence.note: Follow the guard and use the hiding points to keep out of sight.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The guard’s route reveals the meeting place.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Restart the tail if the guard notices the player or gets too far away.

name: Investigate the meeting place

evidence.note: Try the door and watch the encounter.

name: Report the meeting to Sergeant Tobyn

evidence.note: Tobyn gives instructions for identifying the guards.

name: Mark four guards and correct the mistaken mark

evidence.note: Check the guards around the square and eastern streets. Finish by reporting back to Tobyn.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Four intended guards are marked and the mistaken mark has been removed.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Check the current mark list and speak to Tobyn again.

name: Meet Tobyn on the palace roof

evidence.note: Speak to Tobyn upstairs and finish the audience. Regulus can now take the player to Varlamore.

name: Accept Ennius’s request in Civitas illa Fortis

evidence.note: Start after travelling to Varlamore with Primio.

name: Ask Metzli how to meet the prince

evidence.note: Speak to Metzli in the temple.

name: Meet Prince Itzla in the crypt

evidence.note: Find the prince in the crypt and receive the Varlamore crest.

name: Brief Ennius in Sunrise Palace

evidence.note: Tell Ennius what the prince said and learn which knights to visit.

name: Show the crest to the Cothon knight

evidence.note: Learn which crate the knight wants checked.

name: Search the marked Cothon crate

evidence.note: Inspect the crate on the north-east side of the Cothon.

name: Tell the Cothon knight what was in the crate

evidence.note: Report the crate search.

name: Win the training bout against the Colosseum knight

evidence.note: Show the crest, accept the bout, switch combat styles to bypass protection prayers and speak to the knight again.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The knight acknowledges the won bout.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring gear for two effective styles and switch when the protection prayer changes.

name: Lead the pub knight to the fountain

evidence.note: Show the crest, keep the knight following and speak after they sober up at the fountain.

name: Ask the Bazaar knight about the stolen amulet

evidence.note: Show the crest and ask which citizen has the amulet.

name: Pickpocket the stolen amulet

evidence.note: Find the nearby quest citizen and recover the amulet.

name: Give the stolen amulet back to the Bazaar knight

evidence.note: Return the recovered amulet.

name: Report the four knights’ findings

evidence.note: Finish all four tasks in any order before reporting to Ennius.

name: Find and read the letter at the knights’ headquarters

evidence.note: Search the upper-floor chest and read the letter.

name: Report the letter to Ennius

evidence.note: Show the letter and get directions to the Teomat.

name: Ask Regulus for help reaching the Teomat

evidence.note: Regulus gives the player feed for Renu.

name: Feed Renu

evidence.note: Feed Renu to unlock the quest flight.

name: Meet Prince Itzla at the Teomat

evidence.note: Fly to the Teomat and speak to the prince.

name: Speak to Metzli near the Teomat

evidence.note: Speak to Metzli in the northern building and prepare for the attack.

name: Defeat the eight cultists at the Teomat

evidence.note: Fight the attacking cultists through the encounter and watch the aftermath.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The eight cultists have been defeated and the aftermath scene has played.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring sufficient combat supplies and finish the attack sequence before leaving.

name: Report the attack to Prince Itzla

evidence.note: Receive Thieving XP and unlock the regular quetzal service and Civitas illa Fortis spell.

name: Insert The Fisher’s Flute in Kharedst’s memoirs

evidence.note: Insert the page as a separate interaction after receiving it. Twenty charges are added to the shared pool.

name: Insert Lunch by the Lancalliums in Kharedst’s memoirs

evidence.note: Insert the page as a separate interaction after receiving it. Twenty charges are added to the shared pool.

name: Insert Jewelry of Jubilation in Kharedst’s memoirs

evidence.note: Insert the page as a separate interaction after receiving it. Twenty charges are added to the shared pool.

name: Insert A Dark Disposition in Kharedst’s memoirs

evidence.note: Insert the page as a separate interaction after receiving it. Twenty charges are added to the shared pool.

name: Insert History and Hearsay in Kharedst’s memoirs

evidence.note: Insert the page as a separate interaction after receiving it. Twenty charges are added to the shared pool.

name: Buy stew for Robert O’Reilly

evidence.note: Set aside a small Grand Exchange reserve for one bowl of stew.

name: Buy one Kourend Castle teleport tablet

evidence.note: The Grand Exchange reserve is an estimate.

name: Buy one Civitas illa Fortis teleport tablet

evidence.note: The Grand Exchange reserve is an estimate.
